findings: APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant showed impaired LDL receptor binding
Homozygous p.(Pro955Ser) variants exhibited significantly reduced LDL internalization efficiency compared to healthy controls
Heterozygous p.(Pro955Ser) variants showed intermediate LDL internalization efficiency
rationale: The APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant demonstrated functional impairment in LDL internalization assays using hepatocytes, with statistically significant differences between homozygous/heterozygous variants and controls.
experimental_details: LDL internalization efficiency measured via fluorescence intensity after 30-min incubation at 37°C using LDL isolated from variant carriers and healthy individuals (n=3 replicates).
p2_source_location: Among patients genetically diagnosed with FH (n=234), the p.(Pro955Ser) variant accounted for 9.8% (n=23)
